reel_hook: $6.3 billion hit in one crypto attack

slides.title: Binance hit by $6.3B hack
slides.image_prompt: An open steel vault door with golden coins spilling into darkness, a broken padlock on the floor, cold blue light
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Binance says a complex attack hit $6.3 billion in assets.
WHY IT MATTERS
Blockchain firms link it to North Korea's TraderTraitor.
FOR YOU
Binance paused deposits and withdrawals; it says it will cover all losses.
slides.body: Binance says a complex attack hit $6.3 billion in assets. Blockchain firms link it to North Korea's TraderTraitor. Binance paused deposits and withdrawals; it says it will cover all losses.

slides.title: AI spending spooks tech stocks
slides.image_prompt: Rows of glowing server racks with a thick bundle of cables shaped like a chart arrow plunging toward the floor
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Amazon fell about 7%, Intel about 23% after results.
WHY IT MATTERS
Investors fear AI spending is burning through cash.
FOR YOU
Tech-heavy funds may dip; Nasdaq futures were down more than 2% Friday.
slides.body: Amazon fell about 7%, Intel about 23% after results. Investors fear AI spending is burning through cash. Tech-heavy funds may dip; Nasdaq futures were down more than 2% Friday.

slides.title: G20 ministers meet in Atlanta
slides.image_prompt: A large round conference table with empty chairs and water glasses, a city skyline glowing through tall windows at dusk
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
G20 foreign ministers meet in Atlanta Friday and Saturday.
WHY IT MATTERS
It sets up December's leaders' summit amid deep divisions.
FOR YOU
Nothing changes yet; watch for a joint statement after Saturday's talks.
slides.body: G20 foreign ministers meet in Atlanta Friday and Saturday. It sets up December's leaders' summit amid deep divisions. Nothing changes yet; watch for a joint statement after Saturday's talks.

slides.title: Japan hits its 2% goal
slides.image_prompt: A stack of yen coins beside a thermometer reading warm, cherry blossom petals scattered on a wooden table
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Bank of Japan held rates at 1.25%, highest since 1995.
WHY IT MATTERS
For the first time, it sees underlying inflation near 2%.
FOR YOU
Travelling to Japan? A December rate rise is possible and could lift the yen.
slides.body: Bank of Japan held rates at 1.25%, highest since 1995. For the first time, it sees underlying inflation near 2%. Travelling to Japan? A December rate rise is possible and could lift the yen.

slides.title: Truce lets Oleshky civilians out
slides.image_prompt: A dirt road leading out of a damaged town at dawn, a white flag on a post and aid boxes stacked by the roadside
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Melania Trump-brokered truce lets hundreds leave Oleshky.
WHY IT MATTERS
Residents went months without supplies; it ends Sunday.
FOR YOU
No change at home, but small local deals can still get people out safely.
slides.body: Melania Trump-brokered truce lets hundreds leave Oleshky. Residents went months without supplies; it ends Sunday. No change at home, but small local deals can still get people out safely.

📉 Amazon and Intel sink as AI spending worries hit tech. Tech-heavy funds may have a rough day.
🌐 G20 foreign ministers meet in Atlanta ahead of December's summit.
🇯🇵 Bank of Japan holds at 1.25% and says inflation is near its 2% goal. A December hike could lift the yen.
🕊️ A temporary local truce lets hundreds leave occupied Oleshky.
